chapter: Early life, family and Crescent Orchestra
title: The Crescent Orchestra of Jack Carey
summary: He lists the members of Jack Carey's Crescent Orchestra and the jobs they played: dance halls, picnics and house dances.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: When did you start working in Storyville? When did you begin playing piano over there? Had you played other places before you went to Lula White's? Oh, sure.

You see, a letter band, Jack Carey's Orchestra, called Crescent Orchestra. Do you want to know the name of the man? Yes, if you can remember. Well, the band, the name of the men, the band. Jack Carey, he was manager. Oscar Silvestre, was cornetist. Old man Willie Umfrey was clarinet. Bebe Mathews was drummer. That's Bill Mathews' brother. He's dead now. He died. Jimmy Johnson was bass violin player. And Charlie Moore was guitar player.
Charlie Moore. M.W.R.E. Moore. Well, that was the consist of the Crescent Orchestra.
What kind of jobs did they play?
Oh, well, they played dance halls, played picnics, out at Lake Picnics, you know, Sundays, during the week times, house dances.
